killedBy: formatPadReport states the support verdict per pad, so the reader is not left to infer it (issue #596)
why: Drops the support line from the copied compatibility report. The pane keeps its own, so the two surfaces disagree about the same pad -- and the report is the half that leaves the machine, which makes it the half whose omission survives into an issue thread where nobody can re-run it. `describeSupport` is shared by both precisely so they cannot diverge; this is what proves the report actually calls it.
